derivations.claim: The joint motion map is injective and a local diffeomorphism, so its local inverse labels patch to a global C1 inverse.
The slice map satisfies the compact-Jordan change-of-variables hypotheses, giving the fixed-domain integral representation.
The derivative formula for the inverse is C1 because DH is C1 and matrix inverse entries are cofactor-over-determinant rational functions with nonzero denominator.
Differentiating A(t,chi)=a yields the inverse spatial derivative and the material chain rule.
A local rectangular-difference argument from continuity of the second partials proves their mixed-order equality; differentiating F=D_a chi then gives Fdot=L F.
The determinant permutation formula gives the columnwise derivative; repeated columns vanish and the trace calculation yields Jdot=J theta.
The continuous theta-along-motion integral has derivative theta; multiplying J by its negative exponential gives a zero-derivative function and the stated exponential formula.
The fixed-domain pullback integrand has derivative (D_t q+q theta) composed with chi times J.
Compactness and continuity make the time derivative uniformly continuous over K near t; the mean-value inequality gives uniform convergence of difference quotients.
Riemann integral linearity and the uniform error bound allow differentiation under the integral on a fixed Jordan set.
Substituting the differentiated pullback formula and returning through change of variables gives both transport identities.
If the continuity residual vanishes, the transport identity gives zero mass-integral derivative, hence constant mass integral.
Compact-Jordan image preservation and continuity justify change of variables for the residual; local cubes then force it to vanish pointwise.
The product derivative is J times the continuity residual; zero derivative gives invariance, and invariance conversely forces continuity.

risk_review.notes: Read all 14 proof steps, all 12 direct dependency statements, the reader repair account and empty refuter finding list, and the relevant Abeyaratne §§3.4.3,3.7 and Price §§3.3,3.4.1 passages. Joint inversion uses the open I x U domain and nonzero block determinant; cofactor formulas upgrade the inverse to C2. The rectangular-increment argument justifies mixed partial equality without assuming the conclusion. Column differentiation of the permutation polynomial and the explicit finite trace sum give Jprime=J theta, including nonidentity initial J. Compact Jordan images and continuous integrands satisfy both change-of-variables applications. Local compactness gives uniform convergence of time difference quotients; zero extension and the rectangle integral bound justify differentiation. F9 can be applied on a smaller open time interval inside the uniform-estimate neighborhood. The continuous residual localizes using positive-volume closed cubes; both signs and both directions of each equivalence are checked. Empty K, zero density, null-content K, arbitrary disconnected U, negative t and open endpoints cause no exception. Positivity excludes singular J; no AC, measured input, empirical inference or physical conservation assumption is used. Reader additions at 4.1 and 10.1–10.2 are sound nonfatal analytic justification repairs; current item bytes equal the post-reader hash. Statement and dependencies unchanged; no consumer propagation.
